teaser: Nobody copies your open source ideas; the real advantage is that you keep using your own work from job to job, and a rough public history protects you.
core_idea: Open sourcing your work, including what you bring into and build at your job with your managers aware, is how you keep using it across employers and into your own company; ideas are rarely copied, and an early, rough public history shows it evolved openly, which protects you.
